summary: APA allows authors to use generative AI tools when drafting manuscripts, provided the use is disclosed in the manuscript and cited, and authors verify all AI-provided information and citations. AI cannot be listed as an author. Submitted content must not be entered into generative AI tools because doing so breaches confidentiality of the review process.

evidence.quote: the use of AI **must** be disclosed in the manuscript and [cited]
AI **cannot** be named as an author on an APA scholarly publication.
Authors may use but must disclose AI tools for specific purposes such as editing.
No submitted content may be entered into generative AI tools as this violates the confidentiality of the process.
